evals.prompt: We should buy the $2,000 a month premium odds feed.
evals.expected_output: A frugal-first check before the spend.
expectations: Asks what the existing feeds already cover
Finds the cheapest test of whether the new feed changes results
Puts the cost per member or per month in view
Does not cut a check that protects members or a reviewer

evals.prompt: Cut our cloud costs this month.
evals.expected_output: A spend list with frugal alternatives and protected items.
expectations: Lists the actual spend lines first
Proposes cheaper ways to get the same result
Names what must not be cut: backups, reviews, member safety
